verdict.rationale: Mercury's built-in AI assistant, Command, lets users ask questions about their books and hand off bookkeeping tasks in plain language. Documented tasks include writing journal entries, organizing the chart of accounts, bulk categorization, bulk-assigning GL codes and creating categorization rules, so the core of the story is delivered. All evidence is vendor marketing copy, and it never fully defines which actions Command can perform. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Command's natural-language operation, and in-depth docs on the full range of supported commands and how they are confirmed or reviewed.
